question: Two charges $+4\,\mu\text{C}$ and $-4\,\mu\text{C}$ are placed $20\,\text{cm}$ apart. Explain how the electric field at the midpoint is obtained and state whether the fields due to the two charges add or cancel.

options.A: The fields due to the two charges cancel at the midpoint, so the net electric field is zero
options.B: The midpoint is $0.10\,\text{m}$ from each charge; the two fields are in the same direction and add, so $E_{\text{net}} = 2E_{\text{one charge}}$
options.C: The field due to the positive charge alone acts at the midpoint; the negative charge gives no field
options.D: The fields are perpendicular at the midpoint, so the net field is $\sqrt{2}E_{\text{one charge}}$
